ranking_rationale: The top traces named both option boundaries explicitly and showed why the cited qualitative signals fail to clear either one, so the stated reasoning entails the option actually returned. The bottom traces broke that link in two different ways: factor_memory and direct_forecast each argue one conclusion in their reasoning stage and return a different confidence or a different option in their forecast stage, while principle_memory keeps its link but buys it with an invented -0.3 percent central estimate that no item in a headline-only bank can support.
shared_evidence_note: The banks were not the driver: both E0 and E1 consist of headlines with no numeric content, and the split verdicts appear inside a single bank (principle_memory read E0 to 'below' while case_memory and structure_memory read the same E0 to 'within'), so the disagreement is one of how each trace weighed identical qualitative signals and how strictly it refused to convert direction into a boundary crossing.
